title: Lakeview motel: A motel management game with a twist
author: darrkestkniiight
selftext: I've been working on a game called Lakeview Motel with the help of Claude, it's coming together pretty well and I'm looking for some feedback on it. You manage a motel (obviously) and you are focused on maintaining your reputation by any means necessary whether that be Murder, Calling the police on people, or whatever you want really the game doesn't have a single correct option for how to play it. I'm sharing some clips so people can get a feel for the game but I don't want to share too much about it currently as it's still in development. Claude helped with the code and art since I'm not the best at either as of late. My inspirations were Beholder, Basement, and The Clearview motel episode from American Dad. Let me know what you think.

comments.author: ArtificialBeingsInc
comments.body: For the “no single correct option” goal, one possible situation: a guest reports a noisy neighbor. Calling the police reassures the complainant, but another guest decides the motel feels hostile and doesn’t return. Letting the player see both reactions could make the tradeoff clear without a simple good/bad outcome. I’ve only seen the preview, so you may already have something like this.

replies.author: darrkestkniiight
replies.body: I mostly have this in the game! The only real difference is that the player doesn't necessarily see the full reactions of them, the choices and actions do impact multiple NPCs though in multiple ways depending on what happens. The visibility of the choices are normally quieter than being completely visible but they do impact things alot
